method: Last non-null daily close on or before cutoff, within 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-20. Direct Yahoo chart API used for contemporaneous quotes; official/primary-source FRED alternatives retained. Financial figures are facts, units/conversions explicitly indicated.
limitations: CFTC reports positions aggregated across all maturities; a single nearby future/spot quote gives an indicative USD notional, not exact market value.
Not exchange-certified settlement marks, liquidation risk, margin, delta-adjusted option exposure, or portfolio risk.
FX direct chart API closes differ from Yahoo history web captures; direct timestamped API data retained.
Quote timestamps and report dates are observations, not historical publication-vintage evidence.
